model3d.calibration_note: Measured from cover-B front-plane boundary loops at z=-2.2 mm: screen x=-33.554..10.4045, y=-11.9668..11.9668; knob chamfer centered (28,0), radius 14.1263 at z=-2.2, narrowing to 13.6263 at z=-1.709. Knob radius 13.2 leaves clearance. Screen sits 0.015 mm in front of the aperture to avoid z-fighting. Key placement is an approximation on the -y side near the knob; no confirmed user-key opening in STEP. Built-in is independent procedural geometry, not derived mesh data.
